substantive_reconstruction.witness_semantics_and_rank: FactorsThrough(ι,F) is the existential ordinary REAL product F=AB with finite inner indexι, not a conjugate-transpose/Gram factorization or minimum rank declaration. For finite arrays, each output column is a linear combination of the left factor's w columns, so rank(F)≤w. Empty index width0 has empty sum0; any zero/empty array has a width0 witness, although a supplied construction may deliberately retain a larger width.
substantive_reconstruction.sum_and_negation: Given F=AB,G=CD on inner I,J, let the new left factor use A on inl(I),C on inr(J), and right factor use B,D correspondingly. Summing over disjoint union gives AB+CD with EXACT constructed cardinality w1+w2. Negating A gives(-A)B=-F with same supplied widthw. These are the complete source add/neg constructions; no rank equality is inferred, since F+(-F)=0 can keep produced width2w yet minimum width0.
substantive_reconstruction.quotient_remainder_supplier: For M>0 write T=Mq+r with q=T div M and0≤r<M. If u<q then u+1≤q and Mu+v<M(u+1)≤Mq≤T; if u>q then u≥q+1 and Mu+v≥M(q+1)>Mq+r=T. At u=q the comparison is exactly v<r. Therefore Θ_T=1[u<q]+1[u=q]1[v<r]. The two row predicates are mutually exclusive, so this is a real0/1 indicator, not double counting. L=(1[u<q],1[u=q]),R=(1,1[v<r])^T is an explicit width2 witness. Repeated/missing prefixes or suffixes do not affect the proof.
substantive_reconstruction.suffix_zero_empty_and_boundary_cases: Natural values supply nonnegativity; v<M supplies the strict upper bound. Neither comes from an arbitrary real additive variable. T0 gives q=r0 and the zero threshold. At r0 the second right component vanishes, and every u=q row is0; no equality-at-cut off-by-one occurs because the target comparison is strict. M1 permits only suffix0 and is valid. Empty Y or X makes all target identities vacuous but factors still have their declared shapes; this version keeps M>0 and does not need to choose a suffix element to establish it. In the original Lean theorem M0 is possible only if Y is empty, and the proof's per-column use of hv is vacuous in that case.
substantive_reconstruction.rank_three_counterexample: After dropping only v<M, keep every other threshold condition: X=Y={0,1,2},M1,T3,u(x)=x,v(y)=y. The strict threshold x+y<3 gives exactly K=[[1,1,1],[1,1,0],[1,0,0]]. Expansion on its last row yields detK=det[[1,1],[1,0]]=-1, so rankK=3 overR. A width2 product has column space dimension≤2 and is impossible. Suffix values1,2 violate v<M; all values are still natural and Mpositive. This demonstrates loss of a UNIFORM guarantee, not that every violating instance has high rank; e.g. T0 would remain rank0.
substantive_reconstruction.additive_base_arrays: The real exponential splits exp(a+b)=exp(a)exp(b), with one inner index and no computability assumption on a,b. For p(z)=sum_(r=0..d)c_r z^r, the binomial theorem gives p(a+b)=sum_(i=0..d)[sum_(r=i..d)c_r choose(r,i)a^(r-i)]b^i. Those brackets are precisely shifted Taylor coefficients of p(a+z); source polynomial_add_factorization uses them and degree≤d to truncate at d+1. This needs ordinary binomial coefficients, not factorial derivative normalization inserted inconsistently. d0, the zero polynomial, a0/b0 and lower actual degree all work; constructed widthd+1 need not be minimum. Empty rows/columns can make even an exponential's minimum rank0 despite supplied width1.
substantive_reconstruction.finite_sum_product_cardinalities: A finite product of supplied-width W_l arrays gets inner product-index cardinality product_l W_l. Scalar weights are absorbed on one side; disjoint-union across finite summands gives total sum_j product_l W_(j,l). An empty product is the all-ones array with width1; empty sum is zero with width0. No hidden dense enumeration is needed for these pointwise algebraic proofs, although an implementation may still elect to store factors. These conventions also handle a zero-width factor, zero coefficient and cancellation correctly.
substantive_reconstruction.composite_and_complement_counts: Two qualified threshold suppliers have width2 each. Thus Θ_A E+(Θ_B-Θ_A)P has width2+4(d+1), with band constructed width2+2=4 regardless of possible lower rank. Generic complement1-Θ_B has width1+2=3, giving full three-piece bound2+4(d+1)+3=4d+9. The explicit complementary witness Lc=(1-1[u<q],-1[u=q]),Rc=(1,1[v<r])^T instead gives1-Θ exactly with width2, improving total to2+4(d+1)+2=4d+8. This is a separate valid witness, not a free cancellation of index dimensions. Substituting source degree capd=2k+1 yields8k+12, exactly HermiteBond cardinality. Matching a generic expression to actual piecewise cuts still requires the source's separate affine/cut and branch-value arguments, which the complete module contains; the candidate does not assume arbitrary cuts already match.
substantive_reconstruction.mathematical_vs_computational_cost: Symbolic factor construction and rank≤width do not make arbitrary factor entries cheaply computable. Storing explicit factors takes |X|w+w|Y| real entries, and the proof gives neither an evaluator cost for u,v,a,b nor finite-bit cost/precision/stability for exp, coefficients or integer comparisons. The noncomputable existential source proposition is an algebraic certificate, not a preprocessing algorithm, normalized/isometric state construction, oracle implementation, circuit compiler or gate/query bound. Zero factors need no normalized output interpretation.

Finite distributivity and commutativity of real multiplication turn sum_(i,j)Axi Cxj Biy Djy into(sum_i Axi Biy)(sum_j Cxj Djy). Thus constructed width is w1*w2, not sum and not a matrix product of F,G. Scaling uses(cA)B=cF with same supplied widthw for every realc, including0.
